name: smwmusic-final-fantasy-v-heart-of-weaponry-battle-at-the-big-bridge-remix
title: Final Fantasy V - HEART OF WEAPONRY ⚔️ ~ Battle at The Big Bridge (Remix)
description:
𝓢𝓽𝓪𝓻𝓴𝓵𝓮, 𝓼𝓽𝓪𝓻𝓴𝓵𝓮 𝓵𝓲𝓽𝓽𝓵𝓮 𝓽𝔀𝓲𝓷𝓴... 𝓝𝓸𝔀 𝓲𝓽'𝓼 𝓽𝓲𝓶𝓮 𝓽𝓱𝓪𝓽 𝔂𝓸𝓾 𝓰𝓾𝔂𝓼 𝓢𝓘𝓝𝓚!!
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ- Gilgamesh, 1992

Did a special arrangement of Battle on the Big Bridge from for my 6K SUBSCRIBER MILESTONE!!!

Gotta be one of the GREATEST RPG boss themes to end all RPG boss themes. Seriously, I love this song SO GODDAMN MUCH!!! Gilgamesh's theme might as well be the Ken Master's Theme of RPGs. It's not only my favorite song in Final Fantasy 5, but also my favorite song in the entire franchise. Shoutout to FINAL FANTASY Record Keeper] for having the best version of the song period (and also being a great reference to use for this port).

Super Castlevania IV fake-ass Trumpet jumpscare. lmao


Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi, & Thunder SFX are disabled.
‎‎
There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. F Minor (Original Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. F# Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ3. E Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ4. G Minor (Custom Pitch 3)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. Enables Voice Clip, but at the cost of SMW-Compatibility
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. Disables Voice Clip [turned on by default]

Mod note: reduced the echo delay from $04 to $03 to allow compatibility with the death sound.
